usageNotes: Use this to retrieve the cluster-level options (e.g. migration settings, HA preferences) for a specific PVE remote registered in PDM. Requires the `Resource.Audit` privilege on the remote resource; API tokens are supported. The return schema is not fully typed in the spec (`null`) — inspect the raw response body for the actual option fields returned by the target cluster's version.

examples.summary: Fetch cluster options for the remote named 'pve-prod'

tips: The remote name must match the ID registered in PDM (2–32 chars, alphanumeric with . _ - allowed after the first char).
A `null` return type in the spec means no schema is enforced client-side — the actual response is a JSON object with cluster option fields; log or pretty-print it to discover available keys.
This is a read-only, non-destructive call safe to run in production at any time.
